mapper.sql: SELECT order_id, order_no, request_id, request_no, contract_id, contract_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, warehouse_id, status, order_date, expect_delivery_date, actual_delivery_date, total_qty, total_amount, received_amount, paid_amount, buyer_id, buyer_name, dept_id, dept_name, payment_method, payment_days, settlement_type, currency, delivery_address, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_purchase_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_purchase_order ( order_no, request_id, request_no, contract_id, contract_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, warehouse_id, status, order_date, expect_delivery_date, actual_delivery_date, total_qty, total_amount, received_amount, buyer_id, buyer_name, dept_id, dept_name, payment_method, payment_days, settlement_type, currency, delivery_address, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{requestId}, #{requestNo}, #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{orderDate}, #{expectDeliveryDate}, #{actualDeliveryDate}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{receivedAmount}, #{buyerId}, #{buyerName}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentDays}, #{settlementType}, #{currency}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_purchase_order SET del_flag = '2' WHERE order_id IN #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, order_id, request_detail_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, qty, unit_price, amount, received_qty, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_purchase_order_detail WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
